product_family: Lucid Suite visual collaboration platform: Lucidchart (intelligent diagramming with generative AI features), Lucidspark (virtual whiteboarding), and airfocus (product management/roadmapping). Add-ons include Cloud Accelerator, Process Accelerator, and Enterprise Shield (security hardening add-on). A separate FedRAMP-authorized government offering, Lucid GovSuite, runs on AWS GovCloud and is distinct from the standard commercial product.

certifications.proof_quote: Lucid complies with applicable local and international requirements and maintains compliance certifications, including: ... ISO 27001

certifications.name: PCI (merchant certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Lucid complies with applicable local and international requirements and maintains compliance certifications, including: ... PCI (merchant certification)

certifications.name: FedRAMP Authorized (Moderate) - Lucid GovSuite only
certifications.proof_quote: Lucid is now FedRAMP Authorized at the Moderate security impact level, through sponsorship by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)... Lucid GovSuite includes the Lucidspark virtual whiteboard and the Lucidchart diagramming application.

certifications.name: IRAP (Australia) - Assessed at PROTECTED level
certifications.proof_quote: IRAP Assessed at the PROTECTED Level

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: 'CSA STAR' does not appear anywhere on lucid.co/security or in Lucid's 'Compliance certifications' list. The security page states only that the trust center 'includes our SOC 2, CAIQ, and SIG documentation.' A CAIQ questionnaire is an input to CSA STAR Level 1 but is not itself a vendor-stated CSA STAR certification, and no CSA STAR listing is claimed on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: Lucid is committed to CCPA and GDPR compliance and ensures that it uses an approved framework (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework)... Compliance certifications... EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: HIPAA does not appear in Lucid's own 'Compliance certifications' list on lucid.co/security (SOC 2, PCI, Data Privacy Framework, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, CASA, IRAP). No BAA offering or HIPAA page found on lucid.co or lucidchart.com. Third-party review-aggregator sites claim 'HIPAA Compliant' but this is not corroborated on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not listed among Lucid's certifications on lucid.co/security, and no ISO 42001 announcement found on any lucid.co page.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor states: 'Customer data is not used to train any generative AI models available to third parties.' Lucid AI features run on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service; Lucid stores anonymized/redacted prompts and responses only for internal error handling and analysis, with 'no direct connection to individual Lucid users or documents.' AI features are optional and admins on Team/Enterprise accounts can disable them account-wide. A separate Data Processing Addendum is available for Enterprise customers.
privacy.data_region: Vendor references a 'Global data residency for Lucid' help article without naming exact regions offered. Primary hosting is AWS, with GovCloud used for the separate FedRAMP-authorized Lucid GovSuite.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or 1.3, symmetric key lengths up to 256 (AES), depending on connecting browser.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption at rest for all persisted application data; keys protected by AWS Key Management Service (with an optional customer-managed Lucid KMS under Enterprise Shield).

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform; replicated across multiple availability zones with a 99.9% uptime guarantee for Enterprise customers.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based permissions, principle of least privilege, SAML SSO, two-factor authentication, domain control/verification for Enterprise accounts.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: Public bug bounty program hosted on HackerOne; researchers may also report directly to security@lucid.co.

security.name: Enterprise Shield add-on
security.value: Optional add-on for Enterprise/FedRAMP accounts adding IP allowlisting, idle session timeout, and Lucid-managed KMS.

products.name: Lucidchart
products.category: Intelligent diagramming (flowcharts, org charts, ERDs, cloud/infra diagrams) with generative AI (Lucid AI, AI Prompt Flow) via Azure OpenAI Service
products.data_scope: Diagram content, org/process data, optionally linked cloud infrastructure/data imports
products.notes: Standard multi-tenant SaaS, not the FedRAMP-authorized instance.

products.name: Lucidspark
products.data_scope: Whiteboard content, sticky notes, collaboration data
products.notes: Shares Lucid Suite security/compliance posture with Lucidchart.

products.name: airfocus
products.data_scope: Roadmap, prioritization, and product backlog data
products.notes: Acquired product line under the Lucid Suite umbrella; has its own separate privacy/security article on Lucid's help center.

products.name: Lucid GovSuite
products.data_scope: Same as Lucidchart/Lucidspark but hosted on AWS GovCloud
products.notes: This is the product that actually carries the FedRAMP Authorized (Moderate) designation; the standard commercial Lucidchart/Lucid Suite product does not run in the FedRAMP-authorized environment.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid Individual, Team, and Enterprise tiers; Enterprise adds SSO, admin controls, Enterprise Shield, and a Data Processing Addendum
compare.data_residency: Standard product is AWS/Azure/GCP multi-region SaaS; GovCloud is reserved for Lucid GovSuite. Exact data-residency regions for the standard product are not specified in vendor documentation.

flags: FedRAMP Authorized (Moderate) applies only to the separate Lucid GovSuite / AWS GovCloud offering, not to the standard commercial Lucidchart product.
HIPAA compliance is claimed by third-party review/aggregator sites (e.g. security-profile scanners) but is absent from Lucid's own trust center and security page compliance list.

The term 'CSA STAR' does not appear on lucid.co/security or in Lucid's compliance certifications list. Only a CAIQ document (an input to CSA STAR Level 1) is referenced in the trust center, which is not a vendor-domain statement of a CSA STAR certification.

airfocus (product management sub-product under the same corporate umbrella) has a separate privacy/security document; airfocus's compliance posture is not covered by the Lucid Suite (Lucidchart/Lucidspark) certifications above.
